newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse ends higher after quiet session.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse ends higher after quiet session.

text.p: The Ghana stock exchange ended slightly higher on Wednesday in low volume, dealers said.
The GSE all-share index added 0.83 point to 386.42, pushed up by a rise of 24 cedis in the shares of Pioneer Tobacco to 300 cedis and a 10-cedi rise to 540 in Enterprise Insurance.
Volume was a modest 152,130 shares, including another 7,300 shares in Social Security Bank (SSB) at an unchanged 1,350 cedis.

Dealers said they were still waiting for an announcement by the government on why it transferred 4.8 million shares to the Social Security National Insurance Trust last week. Wednesday's deal appeared to be part of the same transfer, they said.

Elsewhere, shares in Ghana Commercial Bank were also unchanged at 570 cedis. Dealers said the stock had steadied after falling in June when investors had offloaded shares because they were disappointed with a low 1996 dividend.
